scope: Exploratory development sensitivity of existing v1 policies. No significance tests or policy selection.
range_justification: Flotas conservadas del protocolo 8C, no inventario FDNY. Variaciones de +/-20% son perturbaciones exploratorias, no intervalos empiricos: viaje solo en el suplemento entre centroides; liberacion solo en el residual posterior al hospital. Se modifica un factor por vez. Se fija miercoles y flota minima de la rejilla antes de ejecutar, por cobertura de un dia laboral y presion de recursos, sin seleccionar resultados.
aggregation: Equal weight per seed within day; equal weight per day for historical fleet summary. Keep historical and forecast groups separate. Report cut and drained populations separately; unresolved responses are missing, not zero.
budget: 22 scenarios x 10 paired replicates = 220 pairs / 440 runs. No stopping based on observed effect. Final 30-replicate evaluation remains phase8F.
limitations: May validation is used for development; not independent confirmatory evaluation.
June is not consumed in this phase; prior June exposure remains recorded in 8C.
Forecast arrivals are generated from retrospective forecasts and are not new observed incidents.
No GPS, hospital capacity or real fleet inventory. No clinical/operational claims.
